_comment: Registry for GHL unread triage (/ghl-triage and ghl-ingest-agent's triage step). Read by scripts/ghl_unread_pull.py, scripts/ghl_unread_plan.py, scripts/ghl_mark_read.py and scripts/ghl_triage_log.py. The rubric the model applies is methods/ghl-unread-triage.md — never copy it here. Decisions: Albert's spec (GHL_Unread_Triage_Spec.docx) grilled 2026-10-07/08; vault 05_decisions/2026-10-08-ghl-unread-triage.md.
_maintenance: Thresholds, type lists and caps are tunable data; what they MEAN is in the method file. tests/test_ghl_unread_triage.py pins write_mode, the cap, the verdict vocabulary, the rubric version (equal to the method file's) and that approve_verdicts is empty while plan_only.

rubric._bump: Bump here and in the method file's 'Rubric version' in the same commit. A bump discards every cached verdict.

write_mode._flip: Staged rollout, same shape as style-tags.json and supplier-sites.json. While plan_only, the sweep classifies and logs 'would clear' and writes NO approval file and marks NOTHING read — scripts/ghl_unread_plan.py refuses --write-approval under it and scripts/ghl_mark_read.py refuses to run. Flipping to write is a dated decision recorded in the vault (05_decisions/), together with policy.exception_date, policy.approve_verdicts and the dated CLAUDE.md exception for ghl-actions-agent — never an edit made to get a run through. Update tests/test_ghl_unread_triage.py in the same commit.

policy._approve_verdicts: Each clearable verdict is its own switch (Albert, 2026-10-08). Empty while plan_only. A verdict joins only after its pilot bar below is met and a vault decision records it.
policy._cap: All-or-nothing (Albert, 2026-10-08): more than this many clearable conversations in one run approves NOTHING and pushes a notification. CLOSER and SPAM count together. The pilot's backlog is cleared once, supervised, at the switch.
policy._exception_date: The date of the dated CLAUDE.md exception that lets ghl-actions-agent execute a policy-approved mark_conversation_read. While null, scripts/ghl_unread_plan.py writes no policy approval and scripts/ghl_mark_read.py refuses a policy-signed one.

pilot_exit._note: A wrong verdict means the rubric is fixed (version bumped) and that verdict's clock restarts. Wrong NEEDS_RESPONSE / UNSURE never block a switch.

guards._note: Applied by scripts/ghl_unread_plan.py after the model, only ever toward a human (CLOSER/SPAM -> UNSURE). Loosen after the pilot shows what they catch.

batch._types: ignore_types / ignore_type_prefixes are invisible in either direction (internal comments, activity log lines). automation_types are invisible when outbound; inbound they hold the batch. An inbound message of a type in no list holds the batch (unknown_message_type) — fail closed.
non_text_bodies: Message type is currently not supported.
batch._non_text_bodies: Bodies GHL writes in place of media it cannot render (seen on WhatsApp 2026-10-08). Matched exactly after trimming; such a message holds the batch as non_text_content.
batch._observed_2026_10_08: Read-only probe, 40 unread conversations / 1,087 messages. Outbound human = source 'app' + userId (TYPE_SMS 283, TYPE_EMAIL 7, TYPE_CALL 49). Automation = source 'workflow' (TYPE_SMS 98 — 75 of them WITH a userId, TYPE_EMAIL 41, campaign calls) or 'bulk_actions'. Inbound carries no source. TYPE_IVR_CALL arrives inbound, source workflow, status completed with a duration and a recording — not proof a person answered, so it never ends a batch. Inbound TYPE_EMAIL bodies are HTML with the quoted thread, sometimes empty (meta.email.subject only). TYPE_SMS_REACTION bodies quote our message. Call status/duration live in meta.call.

age._note: Albert, 2026-10-08: flag at 24 calendar hours (high priority + one aggregate needs_attention line + 'waiting N days' in Notion Notes). Waiting longer than backlog_days = one count line in the brief, no task; the sweep still judges them.

pull._observed_2026_10_08: GET /conversations/search?status=unread honoured: 100/100 rows unreadCount > 0, total 377 (unfiltered total 7,894). Rows carry unreadCount, lastMessageDirection, lastOutboundMessageAction (manual|automated), opportunities[{id, pipelineId, pipelineStageId, monetaryValue, status}], contactName, contactId. GET /conversations/{id} carries unreadCount, firstUnreadInboundMessageId, firstUnreadInboundTimestamp, lastMessageDirection. Re-reading 40 conversations after listing their messages: unreadCount changed on 0 — reads have no side effect. Unread age by last message: median 5.3 d, p90 14.3 d, max 19.2 d.

log._excerpts: titan-agents-repo is PUBLIC (checked 2026-10-07). Until Albert makes it private (his call, 'later, not a blocker'), the log carries ids, verdicts and paraphrased reasons only — no customer text. A one-line PR sets excerpts true once it is private; then each row carries up to excerpt_chars of what the customer wrote.
log._never_merge: Never merged and never PR'd: scripts/publish_run.py refuses it. Only scripts/ghl_triage_log.py writes it, with git plumbing, never a checkout or a force push.

cadence._decided: Albert, 2026-10-07: hourly 8am-9pm Toronto, Mon-Sat; try every 30 minutes first if the account allows it. It does not: '29,59 7-20 * * 1-6' was refused on 2026-10-08 (minimum interval 1 hour). Minute 59 = the jitter rule ('GHL Unread Triage' is 15 letters -> 1 minute earlier).
cadence._environment: Albert, 2026-10-08: reuse the price-list environment. At the switch GHL_MARK_READ_TOKEN sits in that environment's .env too; tests/test_ghl_unread_triage.py makes sure only scripts/ghl_mark_read.py reads it.

writer._verify: Set only after the supervised write probe at the switch: one PUT on a conversation Albert names, a read-back of unreadCount 0, then a new inbound text that must make it unread again. If GHL rejects the body, stop; never try other endpoints unattended.

outputs._never: Nothing under ingest/<date>/ — /daily-ingest and /notion-sync read that folder wholesale. Message text lives only in the gitignored cache (todo.json).
